questions.question: Were you told you have type 2 diabetes at least 180 days (about 6 months) ago?
questions.original_text: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus for ≥ 180 days prior to screening.

questions.question: Do you manage your diabetes with diet and exercise alone, or have you been on the same dose for at least 90 days of metformin (a common diabetes pill), an SGLT2 inhibitor (a diabetes pill that makes you pass extra sugar in your urine), a sulfonylurea (a diabetes pill that makes your body release more insulin), and/or a DPP4 inhibitor (another type of diabetes pill), alone or together?
questions.original_text: Either treated with diet and exercise alone or on stable (at least 90 days prior to screening) treatment with metformin, a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor, sulfonylurea, and/or DPP4 inhibitor as monotherapy or combination therapy, per approved local label.

questions.question: Are you using insulin now, or have you used insulin in the last 3 months?
questions.original_text: Participant is currently using insulin or used insulin within 3 months before screening.

questions.question: In the last 6 months, have you used any medicine containing a GLP-1 receptor agonist (such as semaglutide, liraglutide, or dulaglutide) or a GIPR modulator (such as tirzepatide)?
questions.original_text: Participant is currently using or used within 6 months before screening any medication that contains a GLP-1R agonist component or a GIPR modulator (either by prescription or as part of a clinical study)

questions.question: Are you using now, or have you used in the last 3 months, any weight loss medicine such as pramlintide, sibutramine, orlistat, zonisamide, topiramate, phentermine, naltrexone, or bupropion?
questions.original_text: Participant is currently using or used within 3 months before screening any weight reducing medication including pramlintide, sibutramine, orlistat, zonisamide, topiramate, phentermine, naltrexone, bupropion.

questions.question: Has your body weight changed by more than 5% in the last 3 months?
questions.original_text: Participant has had a self-reported or medically recorded change in body weight > 5% within 3 months of screening OR has recorded change in body weight >3% between screening and randomization.

needs_human_review.original_text: Participant is currently using sulfonylureas and/or DPP4 inhibitors and is unable or unwilling to discontinue the use of these medications at least 24 hours prior to initiation of semaglutide.
needs_human_review.problem: This exclusion criterion overlaps with an inclusion note about the same medications and stopping them 24 hours before semaglutide; it's unclear how to phrase a single patient-facing question without conflating willingness with current use.
